summary: The Backrooms is a shared survival RPG with persistent player progression across authored and simulation-built levels. Shared player, NPC, combat, appearance and presentation systems serve the world; first-time players create a character, follow a locally staged Level 0 tutorial route, then enter Level 1, while later intro arrivals land in the main Level 0 hub.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 / The Lobby, yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored fixtures, hunters, shifting-wall moments and lore props.
places/intake (3D) - standalone bedroom character-creation room; authored props plus scripts/intake-geo.js shell.
places/tutorial0 (3D, solo ephemeral instance) - hand-built Level 0 tutorial route from ceiling-drop room through halls to Level 1; scene geometry, local sim-built fixtures/lights and wrist unit.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored spaces plus Level 2.1 simulated rooms, zones and agents.
places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards and Boiler Room Death Rats.
places/level6, places/level61, places/level7, places/level8 (3D) - Lights Out, Snackrooms, ocean/Seawatch and Fort Surrender; food-court services, camps, caves and traders.
places/level10, places/level11 (3D) - Bumper Crop farm/outpost and Infinite City generated districts, canal, shops, Realty, tram and traffic.
places/home11, places/debug, places/spamton and other numbered places - furnished home, test room, basement showroom/boss arena and separately configured levels.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares player actions, camera, player template/HUD, routing, cap and Backspace menu action.
templates/player.js + templates/camera.js; scripts/camera.js - ordered player behavior and camera entry; view3 supplies third-person mode.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells + sim.js - place setup and placements; sims build and tick place-local layouts/behavior.
sim.js - world cadence and out-of-bounds handling: players respawn, creatures with state.home return, others are destroyed for manager respawn.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - local title/pause, character creation, intro/arrival and tutorial routing; START enters intake.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js; scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom scene shell, creator opening and timed bedroom intro.
places/tutorial0/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/tut0-geo.js + scripts/tut0-panels-geo.js; places/tutorial0/sim.js - tutorial Level 0 route assembly and local props/lights.
scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js + scripts/cutscene-ui.js + scripts/ui.js - local tutorial beats, captions/letterbox/title and HUD composition.
shared: scripts/lib/screen.js - read-only current-screen classifier and wrist-panel gate/replacer shared by player, stats, craft, rest and main-menu input handling.
scripts/lib/maze.js, level1.js, level2.js, level21.js through level7.js + data - per-level grids, zones, layouts and paths reused by sims, geometry, labels and navigation.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml and scripts/lib/critter-model.js + scripts/lib/data/critter-models.yml + critter/clothes/faces data - shared garment/body/species/head construction for players/NPCs; species data selects head GLBs and palettes, with sex-specific headM/headF assets where defined.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + level data - shared item pools, rolls, remains, parsing and container helpers.
scripts/lib/combat.js + combat.yml + scripts/lib/ballistics.js - shared hit/armor and firearm accuracy/projectile rules for player and NPC combat.
scripts/lib/nav.js + builtin/nav; scripts/lib/footsteps.js + footsteps.yml; scripts/lib/photo2006.js - shared NPC path search, surface sound selection and photographic finishing.
scripts/lib/level8-quests.js, level10-quests.js, level11-quests.js and level21-quests.js - dialogue quest definitions, player-step/HUD updates and rewards; scripts/talk.js dispatches handlers.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/level21/sim.js and places/level61/sim.js - cadence, tick; places/level11/sim.js - cadence, L11_FAR, l11Lean, tick.
places/home11/sim.js - cadence, tick; scripts/home11-door.js - ding and ears.press; scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update; scripts/build.js - onInput, update.
scripts/lib/level8-quests.js and level21-quests.js - quest definitions, setters, finishers and dialogue handlers; level10-quests.js and level11-quests.js - corresponding quest APIs.
scripts/lib/fishing.js - water checks, fishing lifecycle and loot helpers; scripts/bobber.js - spawn, schedule, update, cleanup.
scripts/player.js - player combat/progression/input and fishing handlers; scripts/lib/body3.js - swing3, fire3, stance.

scripts/lib/level11-city.js - layCity, layStreet, tickCity; scripts/lib/level11-shop.js - SHOP, layShop; scripts/lib/level11-elevator.js - elevator schedule/call/ears/update; scripts/l11-traffic.js - update.

scripts/main-menu.js - update, onInput; scripts/main-menu-ui.js - mainMenu; scripts/intake-geo.js - geometry; scripts/wardrobe-ui.js - wardrobe; tutorial and cutscene UI/runner exports remain in their respective files.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, combat/rewards, appearance, karma/rep and level access.
scripts/grab.js - player carry/carryId/carryMul and session held-object state; strength, load, health and stamina limit lifting.
scripts/lib/fishing.js - player.state.fishingState session and canonical water checks, bite/reel outcome and location loot; scripts/bobber.js owns spawned float/session state.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags and sheet state; stat creation mode permits attribute lowering/skill retagging until choices are spent.
scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - focus, loot and sit state; interact.js persists configured storage contents to player.state[saveKey].
scripts/talk.js owns dialogue/shop UI, rapport/trade/rep and authored-choice effects; quest libraries own quest keys/HUD/payout; scripts/l8-use.js owns Level 8 interaction flags.
scripts/main-menu.js - menu/intake/intro/arrival/tutorial route state (menuOpen, madeChar, cut, arrivePending, arrive, tut, t0n, t0cut, t0Done); local cutscene camera/effects/audio are session state.
places/level11/sim.js owns generated city/version and live traffic-light phase in place state (l11Light); scripts/l11-traffic.js owns each car's session speed and position updates.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde, then critter, main-menu and view3; routing is configured there.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js sets title menu/music; START via scripts/main-menu-ui.js records introFrom and crosses to intake; wardrobe close triggers scripts/lib/intro-cut.js; completion crosses to tutorial0 unless state.t0Done, then main.

scripts/lib/intro-cut.js writes player pose/animation, local wall patch/FX, view camera and timed audio/screen effects → scripts/ui.js renders scripts/cutscene-ui.js keyed to state.cut and elapsed local time.

Main-menu arrival routing consumes arrivePending in main or tutorial0 → scripts/lib/arrive-cut.js stages ceiling-drop landing → scripts/lib/tutorial.js starts input/walking tutorial state tut; scripts/tutorial-ui.js reads tut.

In tutorial0, scripts/main-menu.js polls scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js t0Tick; scripts/lib/tut0.js BEATS and positions drive almond-water, HALOGEN stat creation, Smiler, shifting-wall and final-fall sequences; completion crosses to level1 and marks t0Done.
scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js writes t0cut/t0n, player pose/camera and scene effects → scripts/cutscene-ui.js renders captions/letterbox and final title; scripts/ui.js presents t0Fade after the ending.

The tutorial HALOGEN beat opens scripts/stats.js sheet in creating mode; stat UI sends stat actions → stats.js owns attribute lowering/tag allocation; closing is blocked until required points/tags are assigned, then the beat resumes.
scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js → scripts/lib/phoebe.js creates/destroys a local, unsaved critter for a timed watcher beat; Phoebe appearance is built through shared critter-model.js.
Spawn room selection → scripts/routing.js pickRoom preserves accepted requestedRoomId or derives solo room from user identity; engine out-of-bounds → sim.js handles respawn/return/destruction.

Level threshold trigger → scripts/level-door.js maps paired IDs and writes arrival clipKind/calls companion.bring → followers cross; player.js consumes clipKind to xfer.kind and noclip-ui renders transition.

scripts/lib/screen.js derives panel priority from state flags; canOpen/openWrist gate and replace sheet/inventory/craft/rest → their owning input handlers update flags, while scripts/ui.js renders the corresponding panels. main-menu.js uses screen classification to gate pause input.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light and red-zone variants; Level 5 has portal/quest props and scripts/l5-rats.js Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and scripts/l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout, fixture variants, resident schedules and home claims.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC roles, dialogue, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies shared combat/social behavior.
scripts/lib/craft.js + scripts/lib/data/craft.yml - recipes vary by category, cost, skill, bench and output; canonical weapon IDs connect crafting to equip/combat/condition.
places/level21/sim.js + level21.yml + level21-geo.js - shared room blocks vary by room type, zone height, lighting, decor and deterministic layout hashes.
places/level61/sim.js + scripts/lib/level61-extra.js + l61-use/staff/diner/jukebox scripts - food-court venues share service systems with varying menus and Faceling roles.
scripts/lib/level11-city.js + level11-models.yml + art/level11 kits - generated buildings/props vary by seeded district/model/placement; sim adds city life, traffic, tram, advert and canal crossings.

places/tutorial0 + scripts/lib/tut0.js + scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js - one route's authored corridor/fixture definitions feed geometry, local sim placements and player-local timed beats; beat-specific events/cameras vary across stages.
migrationNotes: Intro from intake crosses to tutorial0 until player.state.t0Done; the tutorial final beat crosses to level1 and sets t0Done, while later intro completion routes to main. tutorial0 solo copies use names beginning tutorial0-<id>.

Tutorial beats and cameras run on the local player's main-menu behavior, not the place referee; places/tutorial0/sim.js lays its fixtures once. Keep t0Tick naming, t0cut state and HUD dispatch aligned.
scripts/lib/tut0.js is the shared coordinate source for the hand-laid path, dimensions and beat trigger boxes; keep tut0 geometry, placements and beat positions together when changing the route.
HALOGEN stat creation uses state.creating and state.sheetOpen; points and three skill tags must be allocated before DONE/close succeeds, and the halogen beat waits for sheet closure.

scripts/lib/screen.js is derived, read-only state: priority is cutscene, menu, wardrobe, mahjong, talk, loot, wrist sheet/inventory/craft/rest, then play. Only wrist panels can replace another wrist panel; closing remains available, and the tutorial t0cut exception while sheetOpen lets HALOGEN character creation show its sheet.
Phoebe is a local unsaved timed appearance rendered via critter-model.js, not a persistent NPC; tutorial beat cleanup owns its removal.
